CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
20) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya ro'yxat: eating habits, fussy eaters, on a diet, count calories, seeds, carton, junk food, a few, spicy, look smart, dishes, bread rolls, helpful staff, hot dishes, lower the prices, customers, freshly-squeezed carrot juice, steamed rice, low-calorie foods, vegetarian, comfortable seating.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
21) a) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and write which sound you hear each time: LIKE or 'D LIKE.' Olti nuqtali joy, 1-band ko'k qiya "'d like" bilan to'ldirilgan.
    b) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and repeat the sentences.' Olti gap: 1 I'd like some fresh orange juice, please. 2 I like eating vegetables. 3 We'd like to have dinner at Monty's. 4 We like eating low-fat foods. 5 They like healthy foods. 6 They'd like to have a pizza for lunch.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' va qavsda '(a report about the good and bad points of a place)'.
• TO'Q SARIQ ChIZIQLI QUTI: 'When we write A REPORT ABOUT THE GOOD AND BAD POINTS OF A PLACE such as a restaurant, a campsite, a hotel, etc, we can divide it into three parts:' • 'the INTRODUCTION, where we state THE PURPOSE OF OUR REPORT;' • 'the MAIN BODY, where we talk about THE GOOD AND BAD POINTS with examples. We write each piece of information under subheadings.' • 'the CONCLUSION, where we give our OVERALL IMPRESSION and make our SUGGESTIONS.' 'We can use PRESENT TENSES or PAST TENSES for this kind of report.'
22) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and underline the correct information in the table, then use the table to talk about Romano's.'

O'NG USTUN:
• YaShIL JADVAL (to'q yashil sarlavhalar, och yashil kataklar): ustunlar 'Good Points' | 'Bad Points & Suggestions'; qatorlar 'Food & Prices', 'Service', 'Atmosphere'. Qalin qiya juftliklar - tanlanadigan variantlar:
   Food & Prices | • menu VARIED/BORING, great pasta dishes & interesting DESSERTS/STARTERS • not CHEAP/EXPENSIVE | • wine tasted like VINEGAR/BEER - check quality of wines
   Service | • staff polite & helpful • service very SLOW/FAST | • one waiter was wearing JEANS/A TRACKSUIT - get staff a proper uniform
   Atmosphere | • SOFT/LOUD music, beautiful furnishings, clean tables, friendly staff | • very NOISY/SMOKY - start a no-smoking policy
23) 'Use the information in the table above and the plan below, to write a report about the good and bad points of Romano's (150 - 200 words). Use the beginning given and the text in Ex. 18 as a model.'
   DAFTAR SURATI (spiral, sarg'ish qog'oz): Pushti 'Plan'. 'Introduction' - qiya: 'The purpose of this report is to assess the new Romano's family restaurant in Norwich, which I visited on 27th January.' 'Main Body' - • Food & Prices (good and bad points with examples) • Service (good and bad points with examples) • Atmosphere (good and bad points with examples). 'Conclusion' - 'overall impression and suggestions'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom'. 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' To'q sariq chiziqli quti: • Half a loaf is better than no bread. • Hunger is the best sauce.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '45'.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and write which sound you hear each time: like or 'd like.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va har safar qaysi tovushni eshitganingizni yozing: like yoki 'd like.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - javoblar faqat
yozuvdan.

  ⚠ 1-band kitobda tayyor: 'd like.


⚠ 'LIKE' va "'D LIKE" FARQI:

  I like     /aɪ laɪk/
     = yoqtiraman (UMUMAN, doim)
  I'd like   /aɪd laɪk/
     = xohlardim (HOZIR, muloyim
       so'rov)

  ⚠ Farq faqat /d/ tovushida!
  'I'd' oxiridagi /d/ juda qisqa,
  lekin MA'NO butunlay boshqa:

  'I like coffee.' = qahvani
     yoqtiraman (umuman)
  "I'd like a coffee." = qahva
     bering (buyurtma)


⚠ SHAKL FARQI:

  like + -ING / ot:
     'I like EATING vegetables.'
  'd like + TO + fe'l / ot:
     "I'd like TO HAVE dinner."

  ⚠ "I'd like eating" - XATO!
  ⚠ 'I like to eat' - mumkin, lekin
  Britaniyada -ING ko'proq.

points.noteUz:
⚠ /aɪ laɪk/ yoki /aɪd laɪk/ - /d/ tovushiga
quloq soling.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP - UChTASI 'like',
UChTASI "'d like".

  'd like (xohlardim):  1, 3, 6
  like (yoqtiraman):    2, 4, 5


⚠ QOLIPLAR:

  "I'd like + OT" - 1
  'I like + -ING' - 2, 4
  "We'd like TO + fe'l" - 3, 6
  'They like + OT' - 5


⚠ 'FRESH' va 'FRESHLY-SQUEEZED':

  fresh = yangi (sifat)
  freshly-squeezed = yangi siqilgan


⚠ 'FOR LUNCH':

  = tushlikka.
  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ.

⚠ /aɪd laɪk/ - /d/ ni ayting.

⚠ "We'd like TO" + fe'l.
⚠ 'at Monty's' - egalik apostrofi.

sections.title: Writing (a report about the good and bad points of a place)
sections.titleUz: Yozish (joyning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari haqida hisobot)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a report about the good and bad points of a place such as a restaurant, a campsite, a hotel, etc, we can divide it into three parts.
exercises.instructionUz: Restoran, lager, mehmonxona kabi joyning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari haqida hisobot yozganda uni uch qismga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
HISOBOT YoZISh QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  UCh QISM                        ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) INTRODUCTION (kirish) -
     hisobot MAQSADI:
     'The purpose of this report is
      to assess ...'

  2) MAIN BODY (asosiy qism) -
     yaxshi va yomon tomonlar
     MISOLLAR bilan, har biri
     KIChIK SARLAVHA ostida:
     Food & Prices / Service /
     Atmosphere

  3) CONCLUSION (xulosa) -
     UMUMIY TAASSUROT va
     TAKLIFLAR ('should')


⚠ ZAMON:

  Hozirgi yoki o'tgan zamon - ikkalasi
  ham mumkin.
  ⚠ 44-betdagi hisobotda ikkalasi
  aralash: 'There IS a varied menu'
  (hozirgi) / 'It WAS very tasty'
  (o'tgan - tashrif paytida).


⚠ 'A SUBHEADING':

  = kichik sarlavha.
  ⚠ 'sub-' = ost, kichik.


⚠ 'OVERALL IMPRESSION':

  = umumiy taassurot.
  ⚠ 'overall' = umumiy.
  ⚠ 'an impression' = taassurot.


⚠ 'A CAMPSITE':

  = lager joyi (chodir tikiladigan).

points.en: the introduction, where we state the purpose of our report;
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to state' = bayon qilmoq.
⚠ 'The purpose of this report is to ...'

points.en: the main body, where we talk about the good and bad points with examples. We write each piece of information under subheadings.
points.uz: asosiy qism - yaxshi va yomon tomonlar haqida misollar bilan gapiramiz. Har bir ma'lumotni kichik sarlavhalar ostida yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a piece of information' - 'information'
SANALMAYDIGAN.
⚠ 'a subheading' = kichik sarlavha.

points.en: the conclusion, where we give our overall impression and make our suggestions.
points.uz: xulosa - umumiy taassurotimizni beramiz va takliflarimizni aytamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to MAKE a suggestion' - 'do' EMAS.
⚠ Takliflar 'should' bilan.

points.en: We can use present tenses or past tenses for this kind of report.
points.uz: Bunday hisobotda hozirgi yoki o'tgan zamonni ishlatishimiz mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and underline the correct information in the table, then use the table to talk about Romano's.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va jadvaldagi to'g'ri ma'lumot tagiga chizing, so'ng jadvaldan foydalanib Romano's haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - jadvaldagi qalin
juftliklardan qaysi biri to'g'riligi
faqat yozuvdan.


JADVAL (Romano's restorani):

  FOOD & PRICES
    Yaxshi: menu VARIED/BORING,
      great pasta dishes &
      interesting DESSERTS/STARTERS;
      not CHEAP/EXPENSIVE
    Yomon: wine tasted like
      VINEGAR/BEER → check quality
      of wines

  SERVICE
    Yaxshi: staff polite & helpful;
      service very SLOW/FAST
    Yomon: one waiter was wearing
      JEANS/A TRACKSUIT → get staff
      a proper uniform

  ATMOSPHERE
    Yaxshi: SOFT/LOUD music,
      beautiful furnishings, clean
      tables, friendly staff
    Yomon: very NOISY/SMOKY → start
      a no-smoking policy


⚠ MANTIQIY IShORALAR (audiosiz
  ham taxmin qilsa bo'ladi):

  • 'Yaxshi tomon' ustunida 'BORING'
    bo'lolmaydi → VARIED
  • 'Bad points' ustunida 'start a
    no-smoking policy' → SMOKY
  • 'wine tasted like VINEGAR' -
    yomon vino sirkaga o'xshaydi
  • 'not EXPENSIVE' yaxshi tomon
  ⚠ Lekin ular TAXMIN - audio
  tinglab tasdiqlang.


⚠ 'A DESSERT':

  = shirinlik (ovqatdan keyin).
  ⚠ /dɪˈzɜːt/ - urg'u IKKINChI
  bo'g'inda.
  ⚠ 'a desert' /ˈdezət/ = cho'l -
  ADAShTIRMANG!


⚠ 'A TRACKSUIT':

  = sport kiyimi.


⚠ 'PROPER':

  = to'g'ri, munosib.
  ⚠ 'a proper uniform' = haqiqiy
  forma.


⚠ 'FURNISHINGS':

  = jihozlar, bezaklar (mebel,
  pardalar).


⚠ 'SMOKY':

  = tutunli.
  ⚠ 'smoke' + '-y' ('e' tushadi).

points.en: Food & Prices — Good: menu varied/boring, great pasta dishes & interesting desserts/starters; not cheap/expensive. Bad: wine tasted like vinegar/beer — check quality of wines.
points.uz: Ovqat va narxlar — Yaxshi: menyu turli-tuman/zerikarli, ajoyib makaron taomlari va qiziqarli shirinliklar/birinchi taomlar; arzon emas/qimmat emas. Yomon: vino sirkaga/pivoga o'xshardi — vinolar sifatini tekshirish.

points.en: Service — Good: staff polite & helpful; service very slow/fast. Bad: one waiter was wearing jeans/a tracksuit — get staff a proper uniform.
points.uz: Xizmat — Yaxshi: xodimlar muloyim va yordamchi; xizmat juda sekin/tez. Yomon: bir ofitsiant jinsi/sport kiyimida edi — xodimlarga to'g'ri forma olib berish.

points.en: Atmosphere — Good: soft/loud music, beautiful furnishings, clean tables, friendly staff. Bad: very noisy/smoky — start a no-smoking policy.
points.uz: Muhit — Yaxshi: mayin/baland musiqa, chiroyli jihozlar, toza stollar, samimiy xodimlar. Yomon: juda shovqinli/tutunli — chekish taqiqini boshlash.

  INTRODUCTION
    'The purpose of this report is to

     restaurant in Norwich, which I

  MAIN BODY
    • Food & Prices (good and bad

    • Service (good and bad points

    • Atmosphere (good and bad

    overall impression and

⚠ 150-200 SO'Z:

  44-betdagi hisobot (Monty's) -
  AYNI ShU tuzilishda; uni namuna
  qilib, so'zlarni Romano's
  ma'lumotlariga almashtiring.


⚠ NAMUNA JAVOB jadvalning
  ehtimoliy (mantiqiy) variantlari

  tekshiring.


⚠ 'NORWICH':

  Angliya sharqidagi shahar.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈnɒrɪdʒ/ - 'w'
  O'QILMAYDI!


⚠ 'A FAMILY RESTAURANT':

  = oilaviy restoran.

structure.exampleEn: The purpose of this report is to assess the new Romano's family restaurant in Norwich, which I visited on 27th January.

Romano's has a varied menu which includes great pasta dishes and interesting desserts. The prices are not expensive. However, the wine tasted like vinegar, so the manager should check the quality of the wines.
The staff were polite and helpful, and the service was very fast. Unfortunately, one waiter was wearing jeans, which did not look smart.
There was soft music, beautiful furnishings, clean tables and friendly staff, which gave Romano's a pleasant atmosphere. However, the restaurant was very smoky.
On the whole, Romano's is a very good family restaurant. However, the manager should check the quality of the wines, get the staff a proper uniform and start a no-smoking policy.

modelAnswers: The purpose of this report is to assess the new Romano's family restaurant in Norwich, which I visited on 27th January.

Food & Prices: Romano's has a varied menu which includes great pasta dishes and interesting desserts. The prices are not expensive. However, the wine tasted like vinegar, so the manager should check the quality of the wines.
Service: The staff were polite and helpful, and the service was very fast. Unfortunately, one waiter was wearing jeans, which did not look smart.
Atmosphere: There was soft music, beautiful furnishings, clean tables and friendly staff, which gave Romano's a pleasant atmosphere. However, the restaurant was very smoky.
Conclusion: On the whole, Romano's is a very good family restaurant. However, the manager should check the quality of the wines, get the staff a proper uniform and start a no-smoking policy.
modelAnswersUz: Bu hisobotning maqsadi - men 27-yanvarda borgan Norvichdagi yangi Romano's oilaviy restoranini baholash.

Ovqat va narxlar: Romano's da turli-tuman menyu bor - ajoyib makaron taomlari va qiziqarli shirinliklar. Narxlar qimmat emas. Biroq, vino sirkaga o'xshardi, shuning uchun menejer vinolar sifatini tekshirishi kerak.
Xizmat: Xodimlar muloyim va yordamchi edi, xizmat juda tez edi. Afsuski, bir ofitsiant jinsida edi, bu chiroyli ko'rinmasdi.
Muhit: Mayin musiqa, chiroyli jihozlar, toza stollar va samimiy xodimlar Romano's ga yoqimli muhit berdi. Biroq, restoran juda tutunli edi.
Xulosa: Umuman olganda, Romano's - juda yaxshi oilaviy restoran. Biroq, menejer vinolar sifatini tekshirishi, xodimlarga to'g'ri forma olib berishi va chekish taqiqini boshlashi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL - OVQAT HAQIDA.

⚠ 'A LOAF':
  = bir butun non.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi 'loaves'.
  ⚠ 'a loaf of bread' - 42-betdagi
  idish so'zlari qatorida.

⚠ 'HUNGER':
  = ochlik (ot).
  ⚠ 'hungry' = och (sifat).

⚠ 'SAUCE':

  ⚠ 'source' (manba) bilan BIR XIL
  o'qiladi: /sɔːs/.

items.en: Half a loaf is better than no bread.
items.answerEn: It means that having something is better than having nothing, even if it is less than you wanted.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni ozgina bo'lsa ham hech narsadan ko'ra yaxshi, xohlaganingdan kam bo'lsa ham. (O'zbekchada: 'Yo'qdan ko'ra bor yaxshi'.)

items.answerEn: It means that when you are very hungry, any food tastes good.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni juda och bo'lsang, har qanday ovqat mazali tuyuladi. (O'zbekchada: 'Och qoringa qattiq non ham shirin'.)

patterns.exampleEn: I'd like some fresh orange juice, please. / We'd like to have dinner.
patterns.exampleUz: Yangi apelsin sharbati olardim. / Kechki ovqat qilishni xohlardik.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ HOZIR xohlash, muloyim so'rov.
⚠ "'d like" + TO + fe'l (-ING EMAS!).

⚠ 'to taste LIKE' = ... ta'mida bo'lmoq.
⚠ 'look like', 'sound like' ham shunday.
